label: Trend + commodity relative momentum
desc: The shop replica and the commodity ranking book at equal risk: two different questions about the same markets, 0.4 correlated.
rule: trend_shop_replica 50 (RollingSharpe timing) + xs_momentum_commodities 50 · net caps · 10% target
config:
macro_balanced_with_xs:
  target_risk: 0.1
  base_currency: USD
  constructor:
    type: RiskWeighted
  models:
  - name: trend_shop_replica
    risk_weight: 0.5
    timing:
      type: RollingSharpe
      params:
        window: 63
        sharpe_floor: -1.0
        sharpe_cap: 1.0
        smoothing_span: 21
  - name: xs_momentum_commodities
    risk_weight: 0.5
    timing:
      type: None
  portfolio_gearing:
    type: VolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
  portfolio_timing:
    type: None
  risk_controls:
  - type: GroupDirectionalLimit
    params:
      limits:
        equity_index: 0.3
        rates: 0.3
        crypto: 0.4
  - type: LeverageLimit
    params:
      max_leverage: 4.0
  sizing:
    fx:
      HKD: 0.12749
      KRW: 0.000733
      SGD: 0.78555
trend_shop_replica:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  universe_filters:
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 50000000
      lookback: 63
  vol_estimator:
    type: EWMA2
    params:
      hl_1: 5
      hl_2: 10
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Standard
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_floor: 0.05
  signal_defaults:
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 32
    capper:
      type: SymmetricCap
      params:
        lower: -2
        upper: 2
    position_function:
      type: CappedLinear
      params:
        scalar: 1
        cap: 2
  signals:
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 8
          slow: 32
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 16
          slow: 64
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 32
          slow: 128
    weight: 0.25
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMACrossover
        params:
          fast: 64
          slow: 256
    weight: 0.25
  forecast_div_multiplier:
    type: EstimatedIDM
    params:
      corr_lookback: 252
      cap: 2.5
  asset_allocator:
    type: EqualWeight
    params: {}
  model_gearing:
    type: Forward
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      corr_lookback: 126
      leverage_cap: 5.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 2.0
xs_momentum_commodities:
  asset_classes:
  - futures
  universe_filters:
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: StaticUniverse
    params:
      symbols:
      - AFB
      - AWM
      - CC
      - CL
      - CO
      - CT
      - DC
      - EUA
      - FC
      - GC
      - GD
      - HG
      - HO
      - KC
      - KW
      - LB
      - LCC
      - LE
      - LH
      - LRC
      - LSU
      - LWB
      - MW
      - NBP
      - NG
      - OJ
      - PA
      - PL
      - QS
      - RB
      - RS
      - SB
      - SI
      - WBS
      - ZC
      - ZL
      - ZM
      - ZO
      - ZR
      - ZS
      - ZW
  - type: HistoryFilter
    params:
      min_days: 252
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: LiquidityFilter
    params:
      min_volume: 100
      lookback: 63
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Identity
  signals:
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      vol_estimator:
        type: EWMA2
        params:
          span: 32
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 252
          skip: 0
      ranker:
        type: PercentileRank
        params:
          min_names: 15
      position_function:
        type: QuantilePortfolio
        params:
          long_pct: 0.3
          short_pct: 0.3
          weighting: equal
          dollar_neutral: true
      risk_weighting:
        type: InverseVol
        params:
          target_vol: 0.15
          floor: 0.08
  asset_allocator:
    type: Identity
  model_gearing:
    type: XSVolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
      leverage_cap: 3.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 3.0
  rebalance: daily
  position_smoothing: 10
